claims.statement: PPWR entered into force on 11 February 2025 and applies generally from 12 August 2026 across packaging materials and origins.
Packaging must meet recyclability grades from 2030 or later if delegated acts are delayed, while fee modulation follows the relevant delegated and implementing acts.
German reporting requires material type, component weight and verifiable determination; estimates alone are insufficient.
German domestic producers generally must submit their own data reports, so software should prepare evidence and exports without claiming to assume the legal act of filing.
Dutch 2026 fees vary by material and include additional per-unit SUP charges, supporting a country-specific fee data model.
Poland's BDO provides electronic packaging and product reporting, supporting a locally accessible pilot workflow.
Direct competitors publish self-serve packaging compliance tiers from EUR 29 monthly and a mid-market tier at EUR 299 monthly.

contrary_evidence: The key PPWR design-for-recycling and fee-modulation machinery depends on later delegated and implementing acts, limiting authoritative near-term simulation.
PPWR Connect already advertises declarations, grades, EPR market sheets and API access at published prices, while PackComply targets mid-market FMCG.
German domestic producers generally cannot delegate the filing itself to a broker, limiting a done-for-you submission promise.
National portals and producer-responsibility organisations already provide free registration or reporting interfaces; value must come from upstream data quality and workflow.
Converters may resist a tool that recommends material substitution away from their products.

economics.acquisition_route: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: sell one bounded Poland-Germany corridor implementation to an EPR adviser or packaging-design partner that already serves the as-yet-unselected target category, then test whether that partner can bring repeat cases before any broader channel build. No partner commitment or conversion evidence exists.
economics.capital_required_pln: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: keep the initial corridor build within the founder's available 100000 PLN by excluding broad EU legal coverage and using a partner-operated workflow; actual implementation and specialist-review cost is unknown.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: year 1 would test one paid partner corridor; years 2-3 would need repeatable partner onboarding, case volume and renewal; only observed partner economics could support a later scale and equity path to at least 5 million PLN. Current evidence does not support a numeric customer count, valuation multiple or timing estimate.
economics.founder_time: DESIGN CONSTRAINT, NOT VALIDATION: keep founder work within 5 hours per day by limiting the initial rule surface to Poland and Germany and assigning routine client intake and evidence chasing to the partner; whether support can remain inside that limit is unknown.
economics.gross_margin_basis: UNKNOWN: gross margin would be partner licence and case revenue less onboarding, document processing, rule maintenance, specialist review and exception support; no price, case volume, support load or margin has been validated.
economics.payback: UNKNOWN: partner payback requires measured reductions in evidence-chasing time, correction work or case-cycle time, and none of those savings has been observed.
economics.pricing: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: charge the adviser or design partner a licence for the embedded release-gate workflow plus a usage fee for each governed packaging-change case; set neither price until a paid pilot measures case volume and labour displaced.
economics.retention_or_repeat: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: renewal and repeat usage would depend on the partner making the evidence gate part of recurring client delivery and bringing multiple cases; no renewal intent, case frequency or partner concentration tolerance is known.

fingerprint.customer: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: EPR advisers or packaging-design partners serving one as-yet-unselected evidence-heavy consumer-goods category across a fixed Poland-Germany corridor

fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: the adviser or design partner pays for workflow access and each packaging-change case that reaches a partner-approved evidence release, rather than a brand buying another generic compliance subscription
fingerprint.problem_trigger: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: the partner accepts a client packaging-change case whose component, supplier or market data must be verified before design release or procurement handoff in the fixed corridor

founder_fit: The bounded Poland-led corridor uses the founder's FMCG context, quantitative modelling and document-automation skills without requiring a public-facing personal brand.
A partner-operated workflow could concentrate sales and routine client interaction into a small number of B2B relationships, but that leverage is an unvalidated hypothesis.
The one-corridor scope is designed for the founder's maximum 5-hour daily commitment; actual support load must be measured before expansion.
Employment conflicts remain binding: no Reckitt confidential data, supplier terms, work time or employer relationships may be used without permission.
Country-rule interpretation and legal assurance must remain with qualified specialists and the obligated producer retains filing responsibility.

redesign.economic_effect: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: shifting the buyer and paid event from each brand's recurring compliance workspace to a partner licence plus governed-case usage tests willingness to pay against the partner's own delivery capacity, not against free portals or low-cost trackers. A fixed Poland-Germany rule surface and one-to-many partner channel could reduce maintenance scope and account acquisition effort, while case-linked revenue makes value measurement explicit. Partner conversion, authority to enforce the gate, case volume, prices, margins, savings and renewal remain unknown.

risks: An adviser or design partner may lack authority to make evidence completion a true release gate, leaving the product an optional checklist.
Partner concentration can create slow sales, dependency on a few accounts and insufficient governed-case volume.
Suppliers or brand clients may bypass the workflow or provide incomplete component data, producing confident but wrong outputs.
Low-price incumbents can add partner workspaces, approvals or case-based features.
A scenario estimate can be mistaken for an authoritative fee or legal conclusion, especially while decisive PPWR acts remain unfinished.
Rule changes can stale corridor mappings, while specialist review and exception support can erase software margins.
The obligated producer retains filing responsibility; the partner workflow cannot promise delegated German filing.
A Poland-Germany beachhead may be too narrow to support the founder wealth target, while expansion reintroduces legal-maintenance burden.
Using employer information or relationships without permission would create conflict and confidentiality risk.

structure.commercial_archetype: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: channel-embedded case-management licence with usage revenue per partner-approved packaging change
structure.control_point: UNVALIDATED COMMERCIAL HYPOTHESIS: the adviser or design partner's required evidence-release gate before a packaging design or specification is handed to procurement
structure.critical_dependency: a partner willing and able to enforce the release gate, suppliers that provide verifiable component data, current Poland-Germany mappings and explicit uncertainty for unfinished PPWR acts

thesis: Replace the brand-facing compliance workspace with a partner-embedded packaging release gate for one as-yet-unselected evidence-heavy consumer-goods category and a fixed Poland-Germany corridor. An EPR adviser or packaging-design partner would operate supplier evidence requests, verify component data and approve the evidence pack before design release or procurement handoff; country-ready outputs would follow from that governed case rather than serve as the product's main value. This redesign directly tests whether a partner will pay for delivery capacity and repeat case control instead of asking each brand to pay a premium over free portals and low-cost trackers. The partner channel, authority to impose the gate, case economics and customer savings are all unvalidated hypotheses.
title: Partner-Embedded Packaging Evidence Release Gate
uncertainties: Paid willingness of an EPR adviser or packaging-design partner to buy a licence plus governed-case usage.
Whether a partner can require evidence completion before client design release or procurement handoff.
Which evidence-heavy consumer-goods category supplies enough repeat cases for the fixed corridor.
Supplier response rates, BOM completeness and brand-client adoption inside a partner-run workflow.
Partner-sourced case volume, sales cycle, renewal, concentration risk and repeatable acquisition cost.
Actual onboarding, document-processing, specialist-review and exception-support cost, and therefore gross margin.
Measured evidence-chasing time, correction work, cycle-time savings and partner payback.
Data-use rights for reusing evidence templates, response histories and exception patterns across clients.
Timing and content of future PPWR delegated and implementing acts and the burden of maintaining Poland-Germany mappings.
Whether corridor expansion can support the founder wealth target without recreating an unbounded legal-maintenance operation.
